# Discord Zapret — documentation

This GitHub Pages project contains documentation for the Windows zapret bundle in https://github.com/JuniorClient/discordzapret.

- Main repository: https://github.com/JuniorClient/discordzapret
- Latest release: https://github.com/JuniorClient/discordzapret/releases/latest
- Release tag described in this package: 1.10.4
- Platform described by the repository: Windows 10 and Windows 11
- Main topic: Discord Zapret / Zapret Discord
- Other documented topics: YouTube strategies and Telegram Web hosts update
- Telegram Desktop: not guaranteed by this bundle; README points to a separate proxy such as https://github.com/Flowseal/tg-ws-proxy

- Home: https://juniorclient.github.io/discordzapret/

The project is not an official Discord, YouTube, or Telegram product. The bundle is not a VPN. Network strategy compatibility varies and is not guaranteed.
